about: an availability check on an empty calendar

connector.none: no captured Outlook calendar connector; the Claude side serves the same Graph responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request with the microsoftOutlookOAuth2Api credential: GET /v1.0/me/calendarView?startDateTime=<now+2d>&endDateTime=<now+16d>&$top=50&select=…&orderby=start/dateTime asc, header Prefer: outlook.timezone="Europe/London" (the dates are computed from the wall clock, so the route matches any query)

branches: Switch: availability; Get Events returns no events, so freeTimeSlots finds no date range and returns an empty list
expect.offline: The chat path (Chat Trigger → If → AI Agent with its three tools) hangs off a disabled Chat Trigger and is not run; the agent's tools call this workflow with route availability or message, which is the path this fixture drives. freeTimeSlots treats busy events only and computes slots in UTC (08:00-17:30Z); Get Events dates come from n8n's wall clock, so the fixture's events (week of 18 November 2026) assume a run on 16 November 2026
